similar_features.notes: No prior peer dependency migrations found in this repo. The pattern is standard for TypeScript libraries that expose branded third-party types in their public API.

architecture.notes: Package is an ESM TypeScript library. ts-mls is imported throughout src/core/ and re-exported via src/mls.ts. The public API surface (MarmotGroup.state: ClientState, MarmotGroup.propose()) exposes ts-mls branded types. Moving ts-mls to peerDependencies is purely a package metadata change — no source code changes needed.

testing_and_conventions.notes: Tests run via Vitest on Node 20/22/24, Deno 2, and Bun. No existing type-check fixture. CI uses pnpm 10 with --frozen-lockfile. No e2e infrastructure.
